(async () => { const m = await import('/v5/js/world/mainland/plan.js'); window.__plan = m; const g=window.__game; const D=g.daynight; if (D && D.setHour) D.setHour(13); const hb = m.M_BLOCKS.find(b => b.kind === 'calle'); window.__hb = hb; g.world.mainland.fill({x:hb.cx, z:hb.cz}, 30000); g.player.spawn(hb.rect.x1 + 2.6, hb.cz, Math.PI); window.__goShop = (re, dx, yawOff, side) => { const p = g.player.pos; const list = g.world.shops.filter(s => s.room && s.door && re.test(s.kind)).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.door[0]-p.x,a.door[2]-p.z)-Math.hypot(b.door[0]-p.x,b.door[2]-p.z)); const s = list[0]; if (!s) return 'none'; window.__shop = s; const R = s.room; const c = R.center; const fx = R.facade.nx, fz = R.facade.nz; g.world.interiors.fill(c.x, c.z, 20000); const rx = -fz, rz = fx; g.player.spawn(c.x + fx*(dx||1.5) + rx*(side||0), c.z + fz*(dx||1.5) + rz*(side||0), Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); g.camRig.yaw = Math.atan2(-fx, -fz) + (yawOff||0); g.camRig.pitch = 0.12; return s.kind + ':' + s.name; }; window.__shopInfo = () => { const s = window.__shop; const a = s && g.streetlife.active.get(s.id); if (!a) return 'not active'; return { n: a.visitors.length, q: a.queue.length, payer: a.payer ? a.payer.phase : null, ph: a.visitors.map(v => v.phase + (v.st ? '/' + v.st : '') + (v.c.fig.carryL ? '+' + v.c.fig.carryL : '') + (v.c.fig.carry ? '+' + v.c.fig.carry : '')).join(' '), extras: a.extras.length, staff: !!a.staffer }; }; return { hb: [hb.col, hb.row], int: g.world.interiors.info() }; })()

(() => { const g = window.__game; g.world.shops.forEach(s => s.muralChance = 0); if (g.world.mainland && g.world.mainland.stream) g.world.mainland.stream.scale = 0.45; g.money.earn(2000, 'test'); return g.money.cash; })()

(async () => { const g = window.__game, s = window.__shop, P = g.player; const F = async (n, k = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) { window.__frame(n); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 20)); } }; const A = () => g.streetlife.active.get(window.__shop.id); window.__camOverride = null; const r = window.__goShop(/^jewelry$/, 1.8, 0.3); await F(30, 2); return r; })()
